manage.revokePhoneNote: After this, every device is signed out right away and the current password stops working. Send the invite link again so the employee can create a new password. Until then, add punches with "Add record".
manage.resignHint: Sign-in is blocked right away. Records are not deleted.
manage.resignNote: Access is cut off immediately. Records and the account stay, and you can reinstate later if needed.
manage.reason_required: Enter a reason of at least 2 characters (up to 200).
manage.self_change: You cannot change your own account. Ask another admin.
manage.already: It is already in that state. Please refresh.
manage.employee_inactive: An inactive employee cannot be given a role.
manage.min_admins: This would leave fewer than 2 admins. Make another employee an admin first.
manage.min_payroll: This would leave no one with payroll access. Give another admin payroll access first.
manage.payroll_only_grant: Only someone with payroll access can give or remove it.
manage.payroll_needs_admin: Only an admin can have payroll access.
manage.pendingWait: It takes effect when another admin confirms.
manage.pendingHide: A role change request is waiting for confirmation. You can change it again after it is handled.
manage.request_pending: A role change for this employee is already waiting for confirmation.
manage.self_decision: You cannot confirm a change you requested. Another admin must confirm it.
manage.forbidden: Only the admin who requested it can cancel.
manage.revokeDeviceHint: When they changed or lost their phone. The password stays the same.
manage.revokeDeviceNote: After this, that device can no longer punch. The employee signs in on the new phone and registers it. Until then, add punches with "Add record".
manage.owner_only: Only the owner can change the owner account's role, status or sign-in.
manage.readOnly: This screen shows what is currently fixed in the app. Tell us if anything should be changed.

shiftKinds.title: Shift types
shiftKinds.intro: Types attached to shifts. They are chosen in shift templates and dated shifts.

note.normal: Ordinary work with clock-in and clock-out.
note.deemed: Counts the scheduled hours regardless of clock records.
note.outside: A day worked outside the office.
note.remote: A day worked from home or elsewhere.
note.holiday: Work on a holiday, counted as holiday work.
note.extra: Keeps the usual shift and only extends the end time.

leaveGroups.title: Leave groups
leaveGroups.intro: Groups of leave types. The group is set when a leave type is created or edited.

accrualRule.title: Accrual rule
accrualRule.intro: How annual leave accrues. A reference value is calculated from the hire date; a manager confirms and enters the grant.
accrualRule.r1n: One day accrues for each full month.
accrualRule.r2n: Granted anew on each hire anniversary.
accrualRule.r3n: From the third year, one more day every two years.
accrualRule.caution: Attendance under 80%, perfect attendance and fiscal-year settlement are not checked automatically, so the value is a reference and the manager's entry is what counts.

approvalRules.title: Approval rules
approvalRules.intro: Who approves each type of request.

effect.punch: The clock-in or clock-out record is created.
effect.overtime: Overtime, night and holiday work are recognised.
effect.shift: A shift is created on that date.
effect.leave: The leave is booked and deducted from the balance.
effect.leaveDelete: The leave is cancelled and the balance restored.
effect.work: Clocking outside the office counts as normal work that day.

workInfo.title: Work terms
workInfo.intro: Working conditions such as workdays, weekly rest day and hours. One company-wide default is used for now.
workInfo.caution: Wages and per-employee work terms are not entered yet. They will be added with payroll calculation.

messageTemplates.title: Message templates
messageTemplates.intro: Reusable formats for messages sent often.
messageTemplates.empty: Message templates are not available yet. Notices are written each time in “Notices”.

messageRules.title: Message automation
messageRules.intro: Rules that send messages automatically on set dates.
messageRules.empty: Message automation is not available yet.

schedulePatterns.title: Schedule patterns
schedulePatterns.intro: Repeating work patterns (for example 5 days on, 2 days off) that can be applied to many employees at once.
schedulePatterns.empty: Schedule patterns are not available yet. For now, assign a shift template to each employee.

reportTemplates.title: Report snapshot templates
reportTemplates.intro: Sets of items used when making a report snapshot.
reportTemplates.empty: Report snapshot templates are not available yet. For now, use the monthly summary and the monthly attendance report (Excel).

reportSnapshots.title: Saved reports
reportSnapshots.intro: A report saved as it was at one point in time. Live values are on the monthly summary screen.
reportSnapshots.empty: No saved snapshots. Saving snapshots is not available yet. For now, download and keep the monthly attendance report (Excel) from the monthly summary.

closing.title: Closing
closing.intro: Closed periods for each employee. Records on a closed (confirmed) day cannot be corrected or entered by proxy.
closing.caution: Closing currently means confirming records day by day. Closing or reopening a whole month at once is not available yet.

manage.makeManagerHint: Can view records, schedules and leave of staff in assigned branches and approve or reject their requests. Cannot add, edit, confirm, close, see payroll or change settings. Pick the branches after assigning.
manage.scopeHint: Only staff in the selected branches are visible to this branch manager. Selecting a department includes its teams.
manage.scopeNoGroups: There are no branches. Create them in the org chart first.
manage.scopeEmpty: No branch assigned — only their own records are visible now.
manage.not_manager: Pick branches after the person is made a branch manager.
manage.setLevelHint: Super admin and CEO approve and edit everything (their own too); general admins do everything except for them. One each.
manage.rank: Your role cannot change this person.
manage.level_taken: Up to 3 super admins (including the CEO). Change one of them to employee first.
manage.gradeNote: Changes that need another admin take effect after confirmation. The reason is logged.
manage.gradePending: Waiting for another admin to confirm.

gradeHint.super: Approves and edits everything, can add, edit or delete leave and punch records directly, incl. own requests
gradeHint.ceo: Approves and edits everything, incl. own requests
gradeHint.general: Approves and edits everything except CEO and super admin
gradeHint.manager: Approves or rejects requests of employees in their branch only

manage.super_full: Up to 3 super admins (including the CEO). Change one of them to employee first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.ruleNone: No work hours yet. Lateness and overtime cannot be judged until you add them.
settings.ruleAddHint: This does not edit the current rule. It adds a new rule that applies from the date you choose; earlier dates keep the results of the old rule.
settings.ruleNote: A rule already in effect cannot be hidden (past dates were judged by it).
settings.holidayNone: No holidays registered. Public holidays are counted as working days.
settings.holidayDateHint: Only dates on or after {date} (so past months do not change).
settings.holidayNote: Work on a holiday counts as holiday work. Add temporary public holidays here when they are announced.
settings.hereYes: This device ({ip}) is on the office internet.
settings.hereNo: This device ({ip}) is not a registered office address.
settings.hereUnknown: The internet address of this device could not be read.
settings.networkNone: No address registered. Until then every punch is marked "outside the office".
settings.networkAddHint: The most reliable way: open this screen on a device connected to the office WiFi and tap "Use this device".
settings.networkNote: If the office internet changes, add the new address. Keep the old one for a few days rather than turning it off right away.
settings.invalid_time: The start time must be earlier than the end time (HH:MM).
settings.invalid_break: Enter both break start and end or leave both empty, and keep them inside work hours.
settings.invalid_workdays: Choose at least one working day, and the weekly rest day must not be a working day.
settings.past_date: A past date cannot be used.
settings.duplicate_rule: A rule already starts on that date. Hide that rule first.
settings.rule_in_use: A rule already in effect cannot be hidden. Add a new rule to change it.
settings.duplicate_holiday: That date is already a holiday.
settings.invalid_cidr: Check the address. Example: 203.0.113.7 or 203.0.113.0/24 (very wide ranges are not accepted).
settings.gpsOn: GPS check is on. When someone punches away from the office internet, the phone also sends its location; inside the radius counts as the office.
settings.gpsOff: GPS check is off. Register an office location to turn it on.
settings.locationAddHint: Most accurate: open this screen inside the office and tap "Use my location". Indoors the error can be tens of metres, so a radius around 100 m is recommended.
settings.locationFailed: Could not get the location. Allow location access in the browser or enter the coordinates yourself.
settings.locationNote: Location is requested only when the office internet check fails. A location judged outside the office is not stored. Collecting staff location requires prior consent.
settings.invalid_location: Check the latitude, longitude and radius (30–1000 m).
settings.break2Start: Second break start (leave empty if none)
settings.roundValue: {n}-minute steps — clock-in rounds up, clock-out rounds down
settings.roundHint: Example: with 15-minute steps, a 07:29 clock-in counts as 07:30 and a 20:47 clock-out as 20:45. The recorded times themselves are kept.

pc.descGeneral: Manage the week basis and company holidays.
pc.descWork: Manage the company's default working hours and workdays. Per-employee hours are set with shift templates.
pc.descPunch: Manage where staff clock in, how payable time is rounded, and how the office is verified.
pc.descBreak: Manage breaks that are deducted from working time automatically.
pc.weekStartNote: The 40-hour week and overtime are counted from Monday to Sunday.
pc.deemedNote: On days whose shift type is “Deemed work”, the scheduled hours are used regardless of clock records.
pc.pcPunchNote: Staff clock in and out only on their one registered phone. On a PC they view records and send requests.
pc.breakNote: Only the part of the work that overlaps these windows is deducted. E.g. working 08:00–12:30 deducts 30 minutes.
pc.manualBreakNote: Staff do not clock breaks themselves.
pc.desc_notify: What the app notifies about. Phone push notifications are not available yet.
pc.desc_access: Rules for who can see and handle what.
pc.desc_branch: How branches (departments and teams) are organised.
pc.desc_staff: Employee accounts and how staff join.
pc.desc_leave: How leave is counted and requested.
pc.desc_request: Request types staff can send and how they are approved.
pc.desc_message: Posting messages from managers to staff.
pc.desc_closing: Locking records so they can no longer be changed.
pc.desc_pay: What this app covers for payroll.
pc.desc_security: Rules for sign-in and record protection.
pc.fixedNote: These items show how the app works today. Tell us if any of them should be changed.
pc.desc_esign: Exchanging employment contracts and similar documents by e-signature.
pc.desc_advanced: Other options about how screens are arranged.

notice.label: Notice alerts
notice.note: A new notice pops up when the app is opened and the bell shows the unread count.

request.label: Request alerts (managers)
request.note: The number of pending requests is shown in red next to “Requests” in the menu.

push.label: Shift start · late alerts (phone)
push.note: Phone push notifications are not available yet.

admin.label: Manager
admin.note: Sees and handles every employee's schedule, attendance, leave and requests. A manager's own requests are handled by another manager.

payroll.label: Payroll officer
payroll.note: Only managers marked as payroll officers can open the payroll screen.

employee.label: Employee
employee.note: Sees only their own schedule, attendance, leave and requests.

change.label: Role change confirmation
change.note: Granting or removing manager rights takes effect only after another manager confirms.

places.label: Clock-in places per branch
places.note: Each branch is linked to clock-in places. Clocking in within a linked place's radius counts as the office.

number.label: Employee numbers
number.note: Each employee can have an employee number.

invite.label: Invitations
invite.note: A manager sends an invite code and the employee creates their own password.

device.label: Clock-in device
device.note: Staff can clock in and out only on their one registered phone. A manager releases the registration to change devices.

hourly.label: Hourly leave
hourly.note: Leave can be taken in hours, such as half days. One day counts as 8 hours.

pending.label: Pending leave
pending.note: Leave awaiting approval is shown separately and not deducted from the balance.

accrual.label: Automatic accrual
accrual.note: A reference value is calculated from the hire date; a manager confirms and enters the grant.

punch.label: Clock-in · clock-out requests
punch.note: Clocking outside a place's radius becomes a request and is recorded only when approved.

correction.label: Attendance corrections
correction.note: Requests to add a missing record or fix a wrong time.

overtime.label: Overtime confirmation
overtime.note: Managers confirm overtime, night and holiday work.

shift.label: Shift requests
shift.note: Requests to add a shift on a date. Approval creates the shift.

leave.label: Leave requests
leave.note: Staff choose a leave type and dates.

leaveDelete.label: Leave cancellation requests
leaveDelete.note: Requests to cancel approved leave. Approval restores the balance.

work.label: Off-site · trip · remote
work.note: When approved, clocking outside the office counts as normal work that day.

approver.label: Approver
approver.note: One manager's approval completes a request. A manager's own request is handled by another manager.

custom.label: Custom request types
custom.note: There are no company-defined request types.

notice.label: Messages (notices)
notice.note: Managers choose recipients, post a message and see who has confirmed it.

translate.label: Translation drafts
translate.note: A draft translation is made for English readers, and changed numbers or dates must be confirmed.

auto.label: Message automation
auto.note: There are no scheduled automatic messages.

day.label: Daily confirmation
day.note: Managers confirm attendance records day by day.

month.label: Period closing
month.note: Closing a period per employee to block requests is not available yet.

monthly.label: Monthly summary
monthly.note: Hours, overtime, night, holiday work, lateness and absence per employee by month, with Excel download.

week52.label: 52-hour week
week52.note: Weeks over the thresholds are flagged on the home and record screens.

snapshot.label: Report snapshots
snapshot.note: Saving a report at a point in time is not available.

scope.label: Payroll scope
scope.note: Totals used for pay (payable time, overtime, night, holiday) can be downloaded.

viewer.label: Payroll screen
viewer.note: Only managers marked as payroll officers can open it.

tax.label: Tax · insurance calculation
tax.note: Taxes and insurance are not calculated in this app.

login.label: Sign-in
login.note: Staff sign in with their own password and clock in only on the registered device.

audit.label: Change log
audit.note: Records who changed settings, employee data and records, and when.

consent.label: Privacy · location consent
consent.note: A consent screen is shown on first use; location is collected only after consent.

ip.label: IP access control
ip.note: Office network addresses are used only to verify clock-ins, not to block access.

use.label: E-contracts
use.note: This app does not exchange documents by e-signature.

homeCards.label: Mobile > home cards
homeCards.note: Staff can turn home cards such as this week's work and work notes on or off on their phone.

bulk.label: Bulk approval
bulk.note: Requests are reviewed and approved one at a time.

brand.label: Company logo
brand.note: The company logo is shown in the top bar and on the sign-in screen.

access.title: Who has which access
access.desc: Of {n} active employees, only admins, branch managers and payroll staff are listed. Everyone else has employee access.
access.how: To grant or remove access, change it on that employee’s screen. Admin access takes effect after another admin confirms.
access.pinResetConfirm: Clear {name}’s console PIN? They will set a new one next time.

scheduleMode.label: Schedule request mode
scheduleMode.desc: How employee schedule requests are handled. Direct: the shift is created without approval and the request is recorded as approved by the employee. Not allowed in closed months.
scheduleMode.setting_same_day: Already changed today. Change it again tomorrow.

places.title: Work locations
places.intro: Register plants, client sites and field sites by coordinates and radius. A punch inside the radius is verified for that location. Locations are turned off, never deleted.
places.empty: No locations yet. Add one with the + button.
places.name: Location name
places.pickHint: Tap the map to set the spot. If you are at the site, “Use my current position” is the most accurate.
places.locateFailed: Could not get your position. Allow location access in the browser or tap the map.
places.branchesNone: No branch uses this location. Unassigned locations apply only to staff of branches with no locations chosen.
places.turnOffNote: Punches here will no longer be verified. Past records stay as they are.
places.invalid_location: Check the position and the radius (30–1000 m).
places.invalid_place: Name must be 1–40 characters; address up to 200.

branches.title: Branches
branches.intro: Register plants and departments as branches and attach work locations to each. Branches are hidden, never deleted.
branches.empty: No branches yet. Add one with the + button.
branches.name: Branch name
branches.placesHint: Choose where staff of this branch may punch. If none is chosen, all active locations apply.
branches.placesEmpty: No work locations yet. Add them in “Work locations” first.
branches.placesAll: No locations chosen. All active work locations apply for now.
branches.hideNote: A branch with staff or sub-branches cannot be hidden.
branches.duplicate_group: A branch with this name already exists.
branches.group_in_use: This branch still has staff or sub-branches. Move them first.
branches.parent_hidden: The parent branch is hidden. Restore it first.
branches.invalid_group: This branch cannot be used as a parent.

shifts.title: Shift templates
shifts.intro: Create templates for different start and end times and apply them to staff. Lateness, missing punches and today’s schedule on the home screen follow each person’s template. Grace period, break and workdays still come from the company work rule. Templates are turned off, never deleted.
shifts.empty: No templates yet. Add one with the + button.
shifts.baseRule: {n} staff without a template use the company rule {start} - {end}.
shifts.noRule: There is no company work rule yet. Set it first so templates can apply.
shifts.name: Template name
shifts.deemedNote: Deemed work: staff on this template are counted as having worked these hours on every workday even without punching. Days with punches are calculated from the punches.
shifts.assignOff: A template that is turned off cannot be applied. Turn it back on first.
shifts.assignSaved: Applied. Judgements use this template from today.
shifts.invalid_time: End time must be later than start time. Shifts past midnight are not supported yet.
shifts.duplicate_template: A template with this name already exists.
shifts.template_in_use: Staff are still on this template. Move them to another template first.
shifts.template_off: This template is turned off. Turn it on before applying.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.intro: Pick a day to see who works from when to when. A shift entered for that date (holiday work, overtime block, a one-day change) comes first, then the usual template, then the company work rule. Lateness and missing punches follow this schedule.
schedule.empty: No schedule on this day (a day off, or no staff).
schedule.noRule: There is no company work rule yet. Set it in company settings first.
schedule.extraNote: Overtime block: the usual schedule for that day stays, and only its end time is extended to the end of this block.
schedule.breakNone: No break window overlaps this time.
schedule.breakNoRule: The company rule has no break window.
schedule.breakDeemed: Deemed work is counted by the scheduled time as it is.
schedule.invalid_time: End time must be later than start time. Shifts past midnight are not supported yet.
schedule.hint: The time next to each date is the planned total for the people shown (start to end, breaks included). Up to 31 days at a time. ✕ cancels only schedules added for a specific date.
schedule.pcIntro: See everyone's shifts on a calendar and add or change shifts by date.

leaveTypes.title: Leave types
leaveTypes.intro: These are the leave types staff choose when requesting. Types can be hourly (e.g. morning half day 4 h 08:00–12:00, 1 h outing). Days deducted from annual leave = hours ÷ 8. When a leave with set times is approved, that time is not counted as late or early leave.
leaveTypes.name: Name
leaveTypes.builtinNote: The name and hours of default types cannot be changed. Create a new type if you need different hours.
leaveTypes.freeTimeNote: Without set times, staff enter a start time when requesting (optional).
leaveTypes.fullDayNote: Full-day leave does not need set times.
leaveTypes.turnOffHint: Turning off only removes it from new requests. Existing leave stays.
leaveTypes.turnOnHint: Staff can choose it again once on.
leaveTypes.invalid_time: End time must be later than start time.
leaveTypes.duplicate_type: A type with the same name already exists.
leaveTypes.leave_type_in_use: A used leave type cannot change duration, pay or balance treatment. Create a new type.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.intro: Labels that group staff by pay type or rank (e.g. 1. Hourly, 2. Salaried, 3. Manager: team lead). Each person has one, and the color bar in the schedule list uses this color. Not used in pay calculation yet.
jobs.empty: No jobs yet. Add one with the + button.
jobs.name: Job name
jobs.assignOff: Staff cannot be added to a job that is off.
jobs.duplicate_job: A job with the same name already exists.
jobs.job_in_use: Some staff have this job. Move them to another job first.

missing.title: Missing punches
missing.intro: Days in the period where a punch in or out is missing. A missing punch in is flagged {m} min after the scheduled start, a missing punch out {h} h after the scheduled end. Full-day leave, approved off-site work and deemed work are excluded.

empty.in: No missing punch in for this period.
empty.out: No missing punch out for this period.

missing.noRule: There is no company work rule yet, so missing punches cannot be judged.
missing.hint: Tap a row to open that person’s records, where you can add the missing punch. Up to 62 days at a time.

recordList.title: Attendance
recordList.noRule: There is no company work rule yet, so records cannot be calculated.
recordList.hint: The time beside each date is the total working time (breaks excluded) of the staff shown. Tap a row to correct or add records for that person. Up to 62 days at a time.
recordList.addHint: Choose an employee to enter the date, time and reason. For your own record, send a correction request.
recordList.pcIntro: Punch records for the chosen period, one per line. Click a line to fix or add that day; the circle on the right confirms the day.

recordDetail.title: Attendance record
recordDetail.hint: Work and break times are for the whole day. Records are changed only through corrections.
recordDetail.cannotConfirm: A clock-in or clock-out is missing, so this cannot be confirmed yet. Fill it in under Edit first.
recordDetail.hintConfirmed: This record is confirmed. It is used for payroll, and corrections are blocked. Undo the confirmation to change it.

scheduleDetail.title: Schedule
scheduleDetail.hint: This is the regular schedule. Changing the template or company rule changes other days too.
scheduleDetail.hintShift: This schedule was added for this date only. Cancel it with ✕ in the schedule list.
scheduleDetail.onlyThisDay: This is the regular schedule. Saving here adds a different schedule for this date only; the regular schedule stays the same.

leaveDetail.title: Leave
leaveDetail.hint: Approve or reject in the inbox; cancel an approval under Approved leave.

confirm.releaseAsk: If you undo it, this day is left out of payroll and corrections are allowed again. Undo?
confirm.no_record: There is no record on this day.
confirm.not_closed: A record with a missing clock-in or clock-out cannot be confirmed. Fill it with a correction first.
confirm.pending_exists: There is a pending correction request. Handle it first.
confirm.self_decision: Your own record must be confirmed by another admin.
confirm.no_rule: Cannot confirm without a company work rule.

leaveAccrual.title: Leave accrual
leaveAccrual.pending: {n} day(s) pending approval are not counted as used.
leaveAccrual.noGrant: No accrual applies on this date. Add one below.
leaveAccrual.addHint: Saving with the same period name updates that entry. A future start date shows as Planned.
leaveAccrual.hint: Accrued days are entered by an admin. Automatic accrual and accrual by leave group are not available yet.

recordCalendar.title: Attendance
recordCalendar.empty: No employees to show this month.
recordCalendar.hint: Top line is clock-in, bottom line is clock-out. Totals show days with records and payable time. Click a cell to open that day.
recordCalendar.pcIntro: See each employee's clock-in and clock-out times for the month. The colour band under a cell is the job colour.

closing.title: Attendance closing
closing.intro: Close each employee’s attendance month by month. Once closed, punches, corrections, leave and shifts for that month cannot be added or changed.
closing.practice: This closes practice records. Real records are separate.
closing.future: This month is not over yet. It can be closed after its last day.
closing.closeConfirm: Close attendance for {n} people for {month}. Records in that month can no longer be changed (it can be reopened).
closing.reopenHint: A reason is required. Reopening lets that month be changed again, and the reopening is kept on record.

result.blocked: Not closed: something still needs attention
result.changed: Not closed: records changed after the review. Check the screen again
result.future: The month is not over yet

closing.note: To close, every day with records in the month must be confirmed and no request may be pending. Deemed work days need no confirmation. People can be closed one at a time.
closing.none: Nobody to close in this month.
closing.close_not_open: It was already reopened or is not closed.
closing.reopenRequested: Asked another admin to confirm reopening. It opens once they confirm.
closing.reopen_pending: A reopen request is already pending.
closing.self_decision: You cannot confirm your own request. Another admin must confirm.

notice.preview: Sends everyone: “{month} attendance closes on {due}. Finish missing-punch and correction requests before then.”
notice.title: {month} attendance closing
notice.body: {month} attendance closes on {due}. After that, punch records, corrections and leave for the month cannot change. Send a [Correction request] before {due} for anything missing or wrong.

leaveLedger.title: Leave ledger
leaveLedger.intro: Records when leave was granted and how it was used, line by line. New leave arrives as a candidate and counts only after an admin approves it.
leaveLedger.stage: Comparison stage: employees still see the balance from the old calculation. Check that both numbers match here before switching to the ledger.
leaveLedger.stagePractice: Comparison stage: employees still see the balance from the old calculation. Usage shown here is from practice requests.
leaveLedger.policyNone: No annual leave rule yet. Start with the standard method and edit it later.
leaveLedger.basisHire: Hire-date basis — leave is granted each year on the hire anniversary.
leaveLedger.basisFiscal: Fiscal-year basis — leave is granted each year on {start}. The first year is prorated by days of service.
leaveLedger.ruleFirstYear: Under 1 year: 1 day per completed month (up to {max}), usable until the day before the first anniversary
leaveLedger.ruleAnnual: 1 year or more: {base} days, plus 1 day every {every} years from year 3 (up to {max})
leaveLedger.policyCaveat: Attendance below 80% and perfect attendance are not checked. An admin approves or rejects each candidate. This rule is a temporary entry pending labor review.
leaveLedger.optCeilHalf: Round up to half a day
leaveLedger.policyEditHint: Editing creates a new version; the previous one is kept. Approved grants do not change.
leaveLedger.candIntro: Create candidates to calculate leave accrued up to today from each active employee's hire date. Pressing again never creates the same leave twice.
leaveLedger.accrualDone: Created {created}. Already existed: {existing}. Skipped (no hire date): {noHire}.
leaveLedger.decideDone: Processed {ok}. Blocked by a closed month: {locked}. Already in use: {inUse}.
leaveLedger.expIntro: Leave whose usable period ended with days left. It is written as expired only when you press the button.
leaveLedger.expiryDone: Expired {n}. Blocked by a closed month: {locked}.
leaveLedger.balIntro: The ledger starts once a grant is approved for the employee. If it differs from the old balance, check the details.
leaveLedger.manualHint: It becomes an approved grant immediately. It cannot be edited afterwards and can be withdrawn only if unused.
leaveLedger.leave_policy_missing: There is no annual leave rule. Start one first.
leaveLedger.leave_version_conflict: Another admin edited the rule first. Refresh and try again.
leaveLedger.leave_effective_from_past: The effective date must be after the current version's start.
leaveLedger.invalid_days: Days must be above 0 in 30-minute steps.
leaveLedger.period_locked: That month is closed. Reopen it first.
leaveLedger.syncDone: Added {n} ledger lines. Blocked by a closed month: {locked}.
leaveLedger.ruleCarry: Carry-over: up to {max} days of expired leave can be carried over and used within {months} months.
leaveLedger.ruleCarryNone: Carry-over: none — leave expires at the end of its period.
leaveLedger.ruleAdvance: Advance use: up to {max} days can be used before being granted.
leaveLedger.ruleAdvanceNone: Advance use: not allowed — using more than granted is marked as over the limit.

carryResult.not_expired: The usable period has not ended yet.
carryResult.no_policy: The carry-over limit is 0. Set it in the leave rule first.
carryResult.locked: That month is closed. Reopen it first.

leaveLedger.advanceOver: Used in advance: {n} d — over the limit
leaveLedger.settleHint: Enter the last day to calculate unused leave as of that date as a candidate. Approving writes the remaining leave as settled in the ledger. The payout amount is decided in payroll. Unsettled advance use is never deducted from wages automatically.
leaveLedger.leave_settlement_stale: The ledger changed after the candidate was created. Create it again.
leaveLedger.leave_settlement_done: A settlement for that date is already approved.

groups.title: Leave policy groups
groups.intro: Separate from teams. Each group can use its own accrual policy or be excluded from accrual. People not in a group follow the default group.
groups.name: Group name
groups.excludedLabel: Do not accrue leave for this group
groups.moveHint: Applies from that date. Existing candidates and grants do not change; the next accrual run uses the new group. Choosing the default group removes the person from groups.
groups.leave_group_default: The default group cannot be excluded or turned off.
groups.leave_group_in_use: People are still in this group. Move them first.
groups.leave_member_overlap: Another membership already covers that date.
groups.leave_policy_missing: Start the default accrual policy first.

anomalies.title: Attendance exceptions
anomalies.intro: Days whose records need a look. If a type set to block closing remains, that employee's month cannot be closed. Fix records on the employee's record screen.
anomalies.policyIntro: Choose for each type whether it blocks closing, is check-only, or is ignored. Saving applies to closing immediately.
anomalies.policyDefault: No saved rule yet; defaults are shown (missing clock-out, unpaired clock-out and overlap block closing).

why.missing_out: Clock-in without clock-out; hours are unknown.
why.overlap: Times overlap or clock-out is before clock-in.
why.duplicate: Clocked in or out twice in a row.

why.early: Clocked out before the scheduled end.
why.no_plan_work: Records on a day off or unscheduled day.
why.unverified_place: Not verified by office network or location.
why.leave_day_punch: Records on a day approved as full-day leave or off-site work.

anomalies.payroll_version_conflict: Another admin edited the rule first. Refresh and try again.

notify.title: {month} attendance check
notify.body: Some days in your {month} punch records need checking.
notify.how: Check those dates under Attendance and send a [Correction request] for anything wrong.
notify.confirmAll: Send a work message to the {n} people who still have exceptions. Sent messages cannot be edited or deleted. Send?
notify.confirmOne: Send {name} a work message about this month’s open exceptions?

leaveTypeRule.title: Request rules
leaveTypeRule.intro: Limits when requesting this type. Leave blank for no limit.
leaveTypeRule.notice: Request at least N days ahead (0 = same day allowed)
leaveTypeRule.leave_version_conflict: Another admin edited it first. Refresh and try again.
leaveTypeRule.weekdaysHint: Requests including other weekdays are blocked. All checked = no limit.
leaveTypeRule.targetsHint: Only the selected teams (with sub-teams) and people can request this type. Nothing selected = everyone.
leaveTypeRule.nameEnHint: Shown on English screens. Blank = the Korean name is shown.

staffPay.title: Pay by employee
staffPay.intro: Each employee's current contract and tax settings. Open an employee to enter the contract, tax and personal items. Anything still needed for payroll shows as incomplete.
staffPay.forbidden: Only payroll admins can view this.

gap.no_monthly_hours: No monthly hours, so an hourly rate cannot be derived (overtime, night and holiday pay cannot be calculated).
gap.no_annual_divisor: No divisor for annual pay (it is never divided by 12 automatically).
gap.insurance_unknown: Some insurance enrolment is still unknown.

staffPay.note: The hourly figure is contract amount ÷ monthly hours, rounded, for reference only. Payroll uses its own calculation module.
staffPay.monthlyHoursHint: E.g. 209 for a 40-hour week. If blank, allowances cannot be calculated.
staffPay.divisorHint: E.g. 12 or 13. If blank, calculation is blocked.
staffPay.contractHint: Editing creates a new version; the previous one is kept and past months use the version of that time. Hours beyond those included are not calculated automatically until company policy is decided.
staffPay.taxHint: Unknown is not the same as not enrolled. While anything is unknown, payroll for this employee is blocked. Give a reason when not enrolled. Reductions and subsidies cannot be entered yet.
staffPay.itemsIntro: Fixed allowances and company deductions applied to this employee every month. Leave the amount blank to use the item's default.
staffPay.itemsNone: No usable items. Add pay and deduction items in Company settings › Payroll first.
staffPay.sensitiveNote: Resident and bank account numbers cannot be entered yet (pending encrypted storage).
staffPay.contract_amount: Enter the amount as a whole number of 1 or more.
staffPay.contract_monthly_hours: Check the monthly hours (not used for hourly pay).
staffPay.tax_child: Children cannot exceed dependants excluding self.
staffPay.tax_insurance_reason: Give a reason for insurance not enrolled.
staffPay.tax_loan: Enter the monthly repayment if repaying a student loan.
staffPay.item_amount: Enter the amount as a whole number of 0 or more.
staffPay.payroll_item_missing: That item cannot be used now.
staffPay.payroll_item_overlap: The same item is already applied in that period. End it first.
staffPay.payroll_version_conflict: Someone saved first or the periods overlap. Refresh and try again.
staffPay.payroll_effective_from_past: The effective date must be after the current version's start.
staffPay.payroll_reason_required: Enter a reason for the change.
staffPay.payroll_forbidden: Only payroll admins can do this.
staffPay.previewIntro: One month calculated from the current contract, tax settings, personal items and approved rates. It assumes no overtime, night or holiday work and no absence, and nothing is saved.
staffPay.previewBlocked: It cannot be estimated for the reasons below.

imp.title: Bulk entry by Excel
imp.help: 1) [Template] downloads an Excel with the current contracts 2) change only what you need (rows are matched by employee no. — do not change it) 3) [Upload] 4) fix red cells in the preview, pick the start date and [Apply]. Nothing is saved before applying; only changed people get a new version.
imp.guide: Do not change the employee no. Pay type: Monthly / Hourly / Annual. Time basis: Actual / Rounded / Schedule. Monthly hours only for monthly/annual, annual divisor only for annual.
imp.fixFirst: Fix the red cells in Excel and upload again.
imp.applyNote: New contracts apply from the start date; earlier dates keep the old ones.
imp.confirm: Save {n} contracts as new versions from {date}? Saved versions cannot be edited or deleted.

staffPay.import_bad_file: Wrong format. Fill in the Excel from [Template] and upload it.
staffPay.tax_relief_sme: To mark the SME tax cut as Yes, enter the rate, start date and basis (end date after start).
staffPay.tax_relief_durunuri: To mark Durunuri as Yes, enter a support rate (pension or employment insurance), start date and basis.
staffPay.tax_loan_period: The student loan end date is before the start date.
staffPay.reliefHint: Only shown when turned on in Console › Payroll › Employee pay. If on and still Unknown, payroll for this person is blocked. Rates are temporary inputs until tax/labor review.
staffPay.reliefOff: The company does not use reliefs (Console › Payroll › Employee pay).
staffPay.payroll_auto_item: Automatic calculation items cannot be assigned as fixed items. Use a statement adjustment.

payRuns.title: Payroll ledgers
payRuns.intro: Create a ledger each month, calculate, review, then finalize. A finalized ledger never changes. Only employees whose attendance is closed are calculated.
payRuns.forbidden: Only payroll admins can view this.
payRuns.practice: A ledger built from practice records. It is separate from live ledgers and is never copied to live.
payRuns.createIntro: Active employees and employees with a contract in that month are included. Nobody is left out for having no records.
payRuns.createNone: Ledgers already exist for the last 12 months.
payRuns.finalNote: This ledger is finalized; amounts and items cannot change. To fix an error, create a correction revision with a reason (this revision is kept).
payRuns.stale: Attendance, contracts, tax settings, items, reference data or adjustments changed after calculation. Recalculate before reviewing or finalizing.
payRuns.hasBlocked: {n} employees are blocked. Resolve and recalculate, or exclude them with a reason, before reviewing or finalizing.
payRuns.missingRef: No approved reference data: {list}. Approve it in Company settings › Payroll.
payRuns.finalizeConfirm: Once finalized, this ledger cannot change.
payRuns.note: Totals are those of the calculation this ledger currently points to and may change before finalizing. Finalizing does not mean the bank transfer was made.

section.EMPLOYER: Employer cost (not deducted from net pay)

payRuns.attNote: Summed from confirmed records of the closed month. Only approved overtime, night and holiday hours are paid.
payRuns.ovHint: Automatic amounts are never edited directly; an adjustment is recorded instead. Press Recalculate after adding or withdrawing. Pay items cannot be negative.

blocker.no_monthly_hours: No monthly hours, so an hourly rate cannot be derived ({detail}).
blocker.no_attendance: Attendance for this month is not closed.
blocker.proration_policy: Joined or left mid-month, or the contract started mid-month. Proration is not automatic — enter base pay as an adjustment.
blocker.policy_missing: No premium policy ({detail}). Enter it in Company settings › Payroll.
blocker.included_hours_exceeded: Hours included in the contract were exceeded ({detail}). The excess is not calculated automatically — enter it as an adjustment.
blocker.negative_item: An item has a negative amount ({detail}).
blocker.notice_required: Billing-notice basis is set but there is no notice ({detail}). Rates are not used instead.
blocker.bonus_prior_missing: The preceding statement is unknown, so bonus tax cannot be calculated.
blocker.withholding_failed: Income tax could not be calculated ({detail}).
blocker.time_basis_unsupported: Overtime, night and holiday hours cannot yet be split on the contract's time basis ({detail}). Switch to actual clocked time or enter adjustments.
blocker.employer_rate_missing: No employer rate, so it is left out of employer cost ({detail}). Net pay is not affected.
blocker.no_bonus_amount: No bonus amount entered. Enter it under Adjustments or exclude this employee.
blocker.insurance_not_calculated: Social insurance is not calculated in a bonus ledger. Settle or adjust separately if needed.
blocker.overtime_unreviewed: {detail} min of overtime below the review threshold was not queued for approval. It is not recognized, so no overtime pay was added. Use an adjustment if it must be paid.
blocker.relief_unknown: Relief eligibility is Unknown ({detail}). Set it in Pay by employee › Tax.
blocker.sme_applied: SME employee income tax cut applied ({detail} KRW).
blocker.durunuri_pension: Durunuri support reduced the pension contribution by {detail} (employer share too).
blocker.durunuri_employment: Durunuri support reduced the employment insurance contribution by {detail} (employer share too).
blocker.below_minimum_wage: The contract hourly wage is below the minimum wage for the month ({detail} KRW). Check with included allowances (calculation was not blocked).
blocker.duplicate_auto_item: An automatic pay item is also assigned individually ({detail}). End the assignment and use an adjustment.
blocker.ordinary_wage_unknown: A payment item has an unknown ordinary wage classification.
blocker.notice_duplicate: Multiple saved notices exist for the same month, person and insurer ({detail}).
blocker.notice_allocated_elsewhere: This notice is allocated to another run ({detail}).
blocker.notice_settlement_duplicate: Direct billing amounts and settlement adjustments overlap. Review the settlement adjustment.
blocker.employer_notice_missing: Employer billing amount missing ({detail}); excluded from employer totals.
blocker.policy_changed_in_period: A payroll basis changed during this period ({detail}). Review the period calculation.
blocker.leave_duration_mismatch: Leave duration does not match scheduled work time ({detail}). Review the leave and schedule.
blocker.weekly_rest_with_absence: There were absent days this month ({detail}). Weekly paid rest was not reduced — whether to drop it for a week with an absence is a company decision. Use an adjustment if needed.

detail.no_family_rule: no rule for more than 11 dependants

payRuns.payroll_run_exists: A ledger for that month already exists.
payRuns.payroll_run_conflict: Someone else changed it first. Refresh and try again.
payRuns.payroll_has_blocked: Some employees are blocked. Resolve or exclude them, then recalculate.
payRuns.payroll_wrong_status: Not possible in the current status. Refresh the page.
payRuns.payroll_reason_required: Enter a reason of 2 or more characters.
payRuns.payroll_forbidden: Only payroll admins can do this.
payRuns.publishHint: Once published, each employee sees only their own payslip. No text or email is sent. Publishing does not mean the transfer was made.
payRuns.payroll_not_finalized: Only a finalized ledger can be published.
payRuns.correctHint: This ledger stays as is and a new draft with the next revision number is created. Members and adjustments are carried over. Fix contracts, attendance or adjustments, then calculate, review and finalize, and publish the corrected payslips separately. A correction revision cannot be deleted.
payRuns.correctionOpen: Correction revision {n} of this ledger is in progress. This revision stays in effect until that one is finalized.
payRuns.replacedBy: This ledger was replaced by correction revision {n}. This revision is kept as a record.
payRuns.payroll_correction_exists: A correction revision already exists. Continue from the newest revision.
payRuns.payroll_superseded: A correction has been finalized, so this revision can no longer be published. Publish the correction instead.
payRuns.bonusHint: A bonus ledger has no base pay or hourly allowances; it calculates only the pay entered per employee as an adjustment. Tax is the difference after combining with pay finalized in the same month (the regular ledger for that month must be finalized first). Social insurance is not calculated in a bonus ledger.
payRuns.bonusNote: This is a bonus ledger. Open each employee and enter the bonus amount under Adjustments, then calculate. Employees with no amount are blocked; exclude them with a reason.
payRuns.existedNote: A ledger for this month already existed, so it was opened instead of creating a new one.
payRuns.diffNone: No one changed from the previous revision.
payRuns.diffNote: Compares the previous revision with this one by employee (calculated only). Differences are not carried to next month automatically — use an adjustment in that month if needed.
payRuns.payroll_basis_unverified: Verify the reference data, company settings, policies and items used in this calculation before finalizing.
payRuns.payroll_duplicate_payment: The same work is included in another finalized run. Check regular/daily runs and revisions.

reports.attIntro: Monthly attendance totals by department and company. Figures for closed employees are final; others are provisional. The Excel file uses the same filters and numbers.
reports.leaveIntro: Annual leave status by department and company. Figures are sums of the leave ledger; the Excel file uses the same filters and numbers. Leave reasons are not shown.
reports.attNote: Only approved overtime, night and holiday hours are counted. Department history starts on 2026-10-13; earlier months use the current department. Attendance rate and daily/weekly trends are not available yet. No amounts are shown.
reports.notStarted: Leave ledger not started (no approved grants)
reports.leaveNote: Usage rate = used ÷ granted (grants usable as of the date). It is n/a when granted is 0. Advance use and expiry are shown separately. Employees whose ledger has not started are not in the totals.
reports.typeNone: No approved leave in this period.
reports.typeNote: Includes non-annual types (family events, sick leave, etc.). Sum of approved request days, unlike the annual ledger.
reports.trendNote: Recounted per month with the same team and basis as above. The dark bar is the selected month. Months without a work rule show “–”. Unclosed months are provisional.

promotion.title: Leave use promotion
promotion.intro: Ask staff with remaining annual leave to submit a plan, and keep the record of notice, read, plan and handling.
promotion.legal: This screen only records the notice, its time, and the plans staff submit. The program does not judge whether the statutory promotion procedure is complete or whether unused-leave pay is waived. Have a labor attorney confirm.
promotion.sample:
Please decide when you will use your remaining annual leave and submit your plan on this screen by the due date.

If no plan is submitted by the due date, the company may designate the dates and notify you.
promotion.summary: Target {candidate} · Excluded {excluded} · No plan {notified} · Plan {plan} · Confirmed {confirmed} · Separate {exception}
promotion.noTargets: No staff had remaining annual leave on the basis date.
promotion.note: Remaining leave is computed from the leave ledger when the campaign was created. Later leave use does not change these numbers.
promotion.fBasis: Basis date (remaining leave as of this day)
promotion.createHint: Creating picks staff with leave remaining on the basis date. Until the notice is sent you can exclude or re-include targets.
promotion.sendConfirm: Send the notice to {n} people. This cannot be undone.
promotion.promotion_locked: Not allowed in the current state.
promotion.promotion_no_targets: There is no one to notify.
promotion.promotion_wrong_state: This person cannot be handled in the current state.
promotion.promotion_note_required: Enter a reason of at least 2 characters.
promotion.legalShort: The app does not decide whether legal promotion is complete

laborCost.title: Labor cost
laborCost.intro: Pay, deductions, net pay and employer cost from finalized payroll ledgers, summed by month, department and employee.
laborCost.forbidden: Only payroll admins can view this.
laborCost.draftNote: Amounts from ledgers that are not finalized are included. They may change; use for review only.
laborCost.blockedNote: {n} blocked statements have no amounts and are not in the totals. (They are not counted as zero.)
laborCost.empty: No finalized payroll ledger matches these filters.
laborCost.note: Total labor cost = total pay + employer cost (employer social insurance). It differs from total net pay. When a correction is finalized only the correction is counted. Departments are current assignments, not those of the month. Day labor and retirement pay are not included.

retirement.title: Retirement pay
retirement.intro: Records retirement pay estimates, final settlements and interim settlements with the inputs and the calculation. For manual verification.
retirement.forbidden: Only payroll admins can view this.
retirement.legal: This screen only applies the common formula (average daily wage × 30 days × service days ÷ 365) to the values you enter. Whether the wage items, excluded periods and ordinary-wage comparison are right needs a labor attorney. Retirement income tax is not calculated — enter the value confirmed by your tax accountant. Pension plan (DB/DC) contributions are not calculated.
retirement.fillTitle: {name} · {kind} — check and correct the values below, then create

from.employment: Service start was filled from the employment period.
from.profile: Service start was filled from the hire date in the profile.
from.after_interim: A finalized interim settlement exists, so the day after it was used as the service start.
from.none: No hire date, so the service start could not be filled. Enter it yourself.

retirement.wageFilled: 3-month wages were filled from finalized payroll ledgers ({months}). Remove items that do not belong in the average wage.
retirement.wageEmpty: 3-month wages could not be filled (the last working day is not a month end, or the three finalized ledgers are not all present). Enter it yourself.
retirement.bonusFilled: Bonus for the last year was filled from {n} finalized bonus ledgers. Enter leave pay, ordinary wage and excluded days yourself.
retirement.fieldNote: Only 3/12 of bonus and leave pay goes into the average wage. If you enter an ordinary daily wage, the larger of the two is used. Amounts are rounded down to the won.

missing.period: The service period (start date and last working day) is missing.
missing.bad_period: The last working day is before the start date.
missing.under_one_year: The service period is under one year (365 days). No amount is produced.
missing.wage3m: Total wages for the last 3 months are missing.
missing.days3m: The number of days in the 3 months is missing.
missing.bad_days3m: The number of days in the 3 months looks wrong (usually 89–92).

retirement.taxNote: The program does not calculate retirement income tax. If you enter a tax amount, also enter its basis (who calculated it, which documents).
retirement.finalizeConfirm: A finalized case cannot be edited. To fix it you must withdraw it with a reason and create a new revision.
retirement.revise: Create a new revision from this
retirement.notReady: To finalize, no inputs may be missing and an amount must be saved. If you changed values, save first.
retirement.formula: Formula: average daily wage = (3-month wages + bonus × 3/12 + leave pay × 3/12) ÷ days in 3 months → retirement pay = daily wage × 30 × service days ÷ 365 (rounded down). Common practice; labor verification pending.
retirement.retirement_overlap: This overlaps a finalized settlement period for this employee. The same period cannot be settled twice.
retirement.retirement_locked: Not allowed in the current state.
retirement.retirement_incomplete: Inputs are missing or no amount is saved, so it cannot be finalized. Save the values and try again.
retirement.retirement_estimate: An estimate is not finalized. Create a final or interim settlement instead.
retirement.retirement_period: Check the service start and last working day.
retirement.retirement_tax_basis: Enter the basis when you enter a tax amount.
retirement.retirement_reason: Enter a reason of at least 2 characters.
retirement.legalShort: For manual checking — confirm with labor/tax experts before paying

insurance.title: Social insurance
insurance.intro: Record whether acquisition and loss filings were confirmed, and put the difference between insurer notices and payroll deductions into a ledger.
insurance.forbidden: Only payroll admins can view this.
insurance.enrollLegal: The program does not file with the insurers. "Confirmed" means the admin recorded the date and evidence (receipt number, etc.) that a filing was processed. Do not write resident registration numbers in the evidence field. Whether someone is insured is set in each employee's tax and insurance settings.
insurance.noticeLegal: Enter the amounts from the insurer notices by hand (file upload comes after we receive the insurer file format). Entered amounts cannot be edited — withdraw the batch and enter it again. Keep the original notices yourself.
insurance.gapNote: People with an employment period but no acquisition/loss rows. The loss date is the day after the last working day. Clicking adds four rows as "Not filed"; turn off insurers that do not apply.
insurance.manualNote: The employee amount is the whole amount the insurer billed for that employee that month (including settlements and refunds). Enter refunds as negative (-). Health insurance includes long-term care.

why.no_run: Pick a ledger to see what was already deducted there and the difference. Only regular ledgers that are not finalized can be picked (for a finalized one, create a correction and apply it there).
why.not_calculated: This ledger has not been calculated yet. Calculate it first.
why.no_settle: Industrial accident insurance has no employee share, so there is nothing to apply. It is kept as a record only.
why.withdrawn: A withdrawn batch cannot be applied.
why.finalized: Cannot apply to a finalized ledger.

insurance.monthDiffers: The notice month ({notice}) differs from the ledger month ({run}). Check that this is intended.
insurance.recalcNote: After applying or removing, press "Recalculate" in the ledger so it reaches the statements.
insurance.diffNote: Difference = employee notice − already deducted. Positive means more to deduct, negative means a refund. Applying adds a "settlement" deduction line to that employee's statement. The same notice amount can go into only one ledger.
insurance.insurance_evidence: Confirming needs the confirmed date and evidence.
insurance.insurance_no_rrn: Do not write resident registration numbers in the evidence field.
insurance.insurance_rows: Check the rows. Employee and employee amount are required, and the same employee cannot appear twice.
insurance.insurance_reason: Enter a reason of at least 2 characters.
insurance.insurance_allocated: This notice amount is already in a ledger.
insurance.insurance_no_diff: The difference is zero; nothing to apply.
insurance.insurance_no_statement: This ledger has no calculated statement for that employee.
insurance.insurance_other_settle: Another settlement for the same insurer is already in this ledger for that employee. Remove it first.
insurance.insurance_no_settle: Industrial accident insurance is not applied to ledgers.
insurance.insurance_in_use: Some rows are in a ledger. Remove them from the ledger first.
insurance.payroll_finalized: A finalized ledger cannot change. Create a correction.
insurance.version_conflict: Someone else changed it first. Reload the screen.
insurance.enrollLegalShort: The app does not file reports with the agencies
insurance.noticeLegalShort: Enter billed premiums by hand from the agency notice

daily.title: Day labor
daily.intro: Register day workers without login accounts as payees, enter work by day, and produce a day-labor ledger and pay statements.
daily.forbidden: Only payroll admins can view this.
daily.legal: Tax uses the common day-labor method (daily taxable pay − ₩150,000 → × 6% → 55% credit; under ₩1,000 a day is not withheld) and awaits tax verification. Social insurance premiums are not calculated — enter them as a "deduction" on the work row if needed. The program does not file day-labor pay statements or insurance reports, and does not transfer money.
daily.payeeNote: The internal number is assigned by the company and cannot change. Same name with a different number is a different person. Do not enter resident numbers or bank accounts here. No login account is created.
daily.engEmpty: None — add an engagement before entering work
daily.engNote: If tax or insurance is "Unknown", that person is not calculated in a ledger (never shown as zero). When you set anything other than "Unknown", write the basis. Periods for the same site cannot overlap.
daily.workNote: The same person, day and site can be entered only once. For split work in a day, use different segments (A, B …). New rows are drafts; only confirmed rows are calculated. Confirmed rows cannot be edited — void and re-enter.
daily.runNote: Builds a statement per payee from confirmed work rows of the month. Several ledgers per month are allowed; work already in a finalized ledger is not included again.
daily.stale: Work rows or settings changed after the calculation. Recalculate before reviewing or finalizing.
daily.hasBlocked: {n} payees could not be calculated. Resolve the reasons and recalculate.

blocker.tax_unknown: Tax setting is "Unknown" or differs between rows.
blocker.unconfirmed_work: There are work rows not confirmed.

warning.insurance_not_calculated: Insurance applies to this person. Premiums were not calculated by the program (only deductions you entered are included).

daily.ruleNote: Tax rule daily-tax-temp-1 (temporary, awaiting tax verification): per day (taxable pay − 150,000) × 2.7%, rounded down to 10 won, zero if under 1,000 won. Local tax is 10% of income tax. This screen is not a filing form.
daily.daily_internal_no: This internal number cannot be used.
daily.daily_payee_exists: A payee with this internal number already exists.
daily.daily_period: The end date is before the start date.
daily.daily_engagement_overlap: Engagement periods for the same site overlap.
daily.daily_basis: When tax or insurance is not "Unknown", write a basis of at least 2 characters.
daily.daily_no_engagement: No engagement covers that date and site. Add one on the payee screen first.
daily.daily_work_exists: Work for the same person, day, site and segment already exists.
daily.daily_work_locked: Confirmed or void rows cannot change.
daily.daily_work_in_run: Work in a finalized ledger cannot be voided.
daily.daily_no_work: No work to calculate this month.
daily.payroll_run_conflict: Someone else changed it first. Reload.
daily.payroll_has_blocked: Some payees could not be calculated.
daily.payroll_stale: Something changed after the calculation. Recalculate.
daily.payroll_wrong_status: Not allowed in the current state.
daily.version_conflict: Someone else changed it first. Reload.
daily.legalShort: Tax is a provisional calculation · social insurance is not calculated
daily.correctHint: The finalized ledger does not change. Create a correction, fix work lines, then calculate · review · finalize again. Labor cost counts only the newest finalized revision.
daily.hasNewer: This ledger was corrected to rev {n}. This revision is kept as a record.
daily.payroll_duplicate_payment: The same work is included in another finalized run. Check regular/daily runs and revisions.

consent.title: Consent to collect and use personal data
consent.intro: To record attendance we collect and use the information below. Please read it and agree. You need to agree to use the app.

basic.name: Employee details
basic.detail: Name, employee number, department and job title, mobile number (if the company entered it)

punch.name: Attendance records
punch.detail: Clock-in and clock-out times, work notes, and your correction, leave and off-site requests

network.name: Internet address (IP)
network.detail: Recorded when you punch, to check whether you are on the office internet.

device.name: Punch device and sign-in information
device.detail: The type of the device you register for punching and a public key for it, and your sign-in password (stored encrypted; the company and managers cannot see it). Biometrics such as fingerprint or face stay on your device; the company never receives them.

location.name: Location
location.detail: If the company turns on the office-location check, your location is checked only at the moment you punch away from the office internet. A location confirmed inside the office radius is stored with the punch. If you send a punch request from outside the radius, the location at that moment (about 1 m precision) is stored with the request so the reviewing admin can see it on a map. No other location is stored, and you are not tracked at other times.

consent.purpose: Recording and managing working hours, the basis for pay calculation, and keeping records required by law
consent.keep: Kept for 3 years after your employment ends, then deleted.
consent.refuse: You may refuse. If you do, you cannot record attendance in this app and must use another method set by the company. Ask an admin if you have questions.
